Patches up to 12 rasters into one, which covers all of them, with the cell size of the first one. Where the rasters overlap, the merge mode decides the value.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Mosaic, Patch, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Mosaic12`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap1` | raster file |  |  | The first raster to patch: the output takes its cell size. |
| `inMap2` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap3` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap4` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap5` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap6` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap7` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap8` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap9` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap10` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap11` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `inMap12` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster to patch. |
| `pMergeMode` | String |  | `INSERT_ON_NOVALUE` | The value where the rasters overlap: INSERT_ON_NOVALUE keeps the first value, SUBSTITUTE the last one, AVG and SUM their average and sum. Allowed values: `INSERT_ON_NOVALUE`, `AVG`, `SUM`, `SUBSTITUTE`. |
